recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR-core source change is warranted unless a future build reintroduces an active DAF Procedure profile page with a duplicated profile suffix.
issue_request: FHIR-8137 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core clarification from the May 2015 DAF ballot asking to remove the extra trailing "(Profile)" from the generated "Procedure Profile (Profile)" section title on the FHIR-core profiles page.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN revision 5973. In git-svn history that revision is commit 7167cf8ed91d904b2b2e486b9bb0e65b0dfa4640, whose patch changed the publisher title token from pack.getTitle()+" (Profile)" to just pack.getTitle(); the subject names adjacent title-cleanup issue FHIR-8136, but the revision matches FHIR-8137's Jira application note.
additional_context: Current core source no longer has an active DAF Procedure profile page to edit. The DAF IG registration in source/igs.xml is commented out, active source/fhir.ini profile inputs do not include DAF, and the archived release2 DAF Procedure StructureDefinition title is already "U.S. Data Access Framework (DAF) Procedure Profile" without a duplicate trailing "(Profile)".
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The historical title-rendering defect was already removed by the revision cited in Jira, and the remaining DAF Procedure material is historical/out-of-current-build rather than a current generated profile title problem.

related_jiras.note: The git-svn revision cited by FHIR-8137 has commit subject "#8136 - remove \"(Profile)\"" and applied the generic profile-title rendering fix.
